headline: Makutano Mining: Félix Tshisekedi emphasizes traceability and processing of minerals
summary: DRC President Félix Tshisekedi opened the 12th Makutano International Business Forum in Kinshasa on November 23, 2026, focusing on mineral traceability and processing. The forum runs through November 25.
why: The DRC is a major producer of copper and cobalt, and traceability rules affect buyers' sourcing and supply-chain compliance.
original_headline: Makutano Mining : Félix Tshisekedi met l’accent sur la traçabilité et la transformation des minerais
